summary: Osisko Development Corp. filed a Form 6-K on May 4, 2026, attaching a press release announcing the appointment of Ms. Sarah MacDonald as Vice President, Construction Contracting and Commercial, effective immediately. The appointment is presented as a strategic hire to strengthen execution capabilities as the company advances its Cariboo Gold Project. No transaction terms, financial details, or board recommendations are disclosed. As a foreign private issuer using Form 6-K, the filing is the equivalent of a U.S. current report on Form 8-K for a management appointment. This is a routine management change with no special-situation implications.
